evidence_span: Fig. 8 shows the effect of temperature on the leaching at 10 g/L S/L ratio, 1 M HNO3, 1.7 vol.% H2O2, and 30 min. The leaching efficiency of Co and Li increased with increasing temperature. The extent of Co extraction was close to 99% at 75 ^∘C,, 75% at 50 ^∘C and 30% at 25 ^∘C, respectively, and that of Li was similar to Co extraction.
